_about: Scientific data library, domain population: the universal columns of the game's body/data/population.json tables, written by scripts/split_data.py. Same columns/rows schema as the game's tables. `id` is stable (see README); `source` holds source keys from sources.json ('; ' separated) or 'open'. Mark is the review state of these columns. A null in a column the engine's data/*.json holds by the same id means the engine file is the home of that value.

cohorts.title: The settlement record: cohorts the aggregate model keeps
cohorts.source: A compact age-sex-role structure, updated daily for a visited town (the overnight tick) and in a batch for a distant one (the days elapsed). ChatGPT's three simulation levels (unvisited aggregate; discovered named characters tracked; active full detail) recorded in COMBAT.md 4e, proposed; kept.
rows: fraction of adults immune to the local fevers
a plantation town's enslaved people; whether this appears in the game at all is Rex's (GOODS.md Open for Rex 1)
sailors, soldiers, visitors in port this week (the recruit pool's visitors, PIRATE.md 7b)
mean body condition of the pool (food sufficiency, epidemic state)
stores against need (ECOLOGY and the economy)
disease id or none, with day
= adults x health x (1 - sick share)
how many farmers, fishers, smiths, sailors (GOODS.md 3d labels) the pool supplies

tick.title: The aggregate daily update
tick.source: Standard cohort-component demography reduced to daily rates; epidemic as a simple SIR-type pulse using MEDICINE.md catch and death rates; migration from the economy's prosperity and the town's reputation. Numbers placeholders.
rows: children += adults_f x birth_rate/365 x health
each cohort -= n x death_rate/365 x (2 - health) ; elders x2

on outbreak: new cases daily = remaining members of the initial resident pool not yet caught and not initially seasoned x the host's catch rate, through the row's maximum course day; each exposure batch follows MEDICINE's uniform integer incubation and course days, with fatal crises uniform over each drawn course; deaths and recoveries are their expectations, and living ill cases determine sick share; survivors join seasoned_share for lifelong immunity (yellow fever, smallpox)
proposed (Reality, 2026-10-30, group 14: the expected value of MEDICINE's individual course)
children -> adults at 15 (1/5475 a day), adults -> elders at 50
food_days -= 1; if under 0: health -= 0.02 a day; births x0.5; deaths x1.5 (famine)
transient += arrivals (ships in port x crew share ashore); adults += settlers (prosperity x reputation x 0.001 a day)
adults -= leavers (fear of fever x epidemic; the dying port's pressure: Rex, everyone thinking of abandoning the port)
labour = adults x health x (1 - sick); the town's places draw workers from it; a place with no labour stalls (an input to the economy, not a fate)
the unnamed candidates (merc, hire) a port offers are drawn from transient and adults by occupation; named characters are never drawn or removed here
